CC: thick painful nails
HPI: weeks of symptoms relating to multiple painful calluses. Sensory neuropathy noted on prior visits.
Exam: plantar callus area consistent with multiple painful calluses; general inspection of the foot otherwise unremarkable.
MDM: addressed an independent problem with risks, data review (X-ray pending), and a management plan distinct from the procedure decision; shared decision making documented.
Procedure: Paring of multiple hyperkeratotic lesions performed. Tolerated well, no immediate complications.
